title: Hyped UP Bunnies
overview: Three exotic dancers, Mercedes, Jaguar, and Alexis accidentally witness a violent gun showdown. Now, they're not just dancing for dollars, they're running for their lives. Leaving their old world in the dust, the trio hijacks a ride-share and ends up taking an unlikely hostage: Mark, a clean-cut youth pastor who just wanted to make a little extra cash. He's about to get a front-row seat to the wildest ride of his life. Hot on their heels is Ricky Roulette, a charming but ruthless hunter-for-hire working for the infamous underworld queen pin Kat Kitty. With each stop, the girls blur the line between survival and seduction, pulling jobs, dodging bullets, and leaving chaos in their glitter-dusted wake.
